title: Protocol for CRISPR/Cas9-based knock-in using the VIKING method
protocol: Incubate HaCaT or human embryonic kidney 293F (HEK293F) cells in Dulbecco's modified Eagle's medium containing 10% fetal bovine serum and 1 U/mL penicillin-streptomycin (D10 medium).
Suspend cells in 400 µL Opti-MEM.

Transfect HaCaT cells with the VIKING module and target genome cleavage vector using an electroporator, using a total of 15 µg DNA with a molar ratio of donor cleavage vector (VKG1-gRNA-pX330):donor vector (pVKG1-PURO):target genome cleavage vector (pX330) = 1:1:17.
Transfer electroporated cells to 100 mm dishes and culture in D10 medium lacking antibiotics for 24 hours.
Suspend HEK293F cells in 400 µL Opti-MEM.

Transfect HEK293F cells with the VIKING module and target genome cleavage vector using TurboFect transfection reagent, using a total of 15 µg DNA with a molar ratio of donor cleavage vector (VKG1-gRNA-pX330):donor vector (pVKG1-PURO):target genome cleavage vector (pX330) = 1:1:17.
Transfer transfected cells to 100 mm dishes and culture in D10 medium lacking antibiotics for 24 hours.
Refresh D10 medium.
Add puromycin (0.3 µg/mL) to the D10 medium and culture cells for 1–2 weeks.
Wash cells with phosphate-buffered saline.
Place the cloning ring on a single colony.
Pick at least 20 colonies.
Add 20 μL trypsin to each ring.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 2 min (HEK293F cells) or 10 min (HaCaT cells).
Transfer cells to a 24-well or 48-well plate.
Incubate cells at 37°C for several days.
Transfer cells to a 12-well plate and incubate.
Isolate a portion of the cells for DNA extraction.
Add 180 μL of 50 mM NaOH and transfer to a 1.5 µL tube.
Incubate at 95°C for 30 min.
Add 20 μL of 1 M Tris HCl, pH 8.0.
Centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 10 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube.
Design primers to amplify the VKG1 sequence.
Design primers that specifically bind to the target genome sequence.
PCR sample using 2× GoTaq GreenMaster Mix, Primer A, Primer B, nuclease-free water, genomic DNA, and total mixture of 25 µL.
Thermocycle the PCR samples.
Heat the mixture to 95°C for 2 minutes.
Perform 30 cycles of PCR: heat to 95°C for 30 seconds, then cool to 55°C for 1 minute, followed by heating to 72°C for 2 minutes.
Incubate at 72°C for 4 minutes.
Maintain the temperature at 12°C until further use.
Confirm random insertion through PCR using Primer 1 and Primer 2 for Amplicon1.
Perform forward direction PCR with Primer 1 and Primer 3 for Amplicon2, or Primer 2 and Primer 4 for Amplicon3 to confirm knock-in in the forward direction.
Conduct reverse direction PCR using Primer 2 and Primer 3 for Amplicon4, or Primer 1 and Primer 4 for Amplicon5 to verify knock-in in the reverse direction.
Mix HaCaT cells with the appropriate transfection reagent for high transfection efficiency.
Mix HEK293F cells with the appropriate transfection reagent for high transfection efficiency.
Mix C4-2 cells with the appropriate transfection reagent for high transfection efficiency.
Mix UMR-106 cells with the appropriate transfection reagent for high transfection efficiency.
Mix MC3T3-E1 cells with the appropriate transfection reagent for high transfection efficiency.
